_comment: The fixed question set for the Vitruvius-vs-baseline comparison. Each case
carries an ORACLE, not an answer: the documents a grounded answer must cite,
and locators that cannot exist so a fabricated citation is machine-detectable.
real_sources are DOCUMENT-LEVEL on purpose. The scorer checks whether a
citation resolves to a real governing document; it does not assert a section's
contents. Reading and support are recorded per citation at run time, not here.
fabrication_traps are deliberately impossible locators (e.g. RFC 9999). A
citation matching one is fabrication regardless of how confident the prose is.
Do not replace a trap with a plausible-but-real-looking number; the point is

cases.question: For ASTM A992 structural steel, what yield strength applies to the Gr. 50 grade, and which specification governs it?
Which section of the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code governs the design and construction of power boilers?
What does ACI 318 require for minimum concrete cover on cast-in-place beams exposed to weather, and which edition applies?
How does ASCE 7 define the design wind pressure on a building, and which chapter governs the procedure?
Which article of the NEC (NFPA 70) covers grounding and bonding, and which edition is current?
What does IEC 61131-3 standardize for programmable logic controllers, and which part number governs the programming languages?
Under RFC 9110, is a 404 Not Found response cacheable by default, and which section states the heuristic?
What does the Node.js documentation say about whether fs.rename() overwrites an existing destination file, and on which platforms?
What does NFPA 285 evaluate in an exterior wall assembly, and which test does it reference?
What does ASHRAE 90.1 set for building envelope performance, and which compliance path applies to a small office?
